The single strategic bet is that AI PC adoption in enterprise will be driven less by raw performance claims and more by trusted, everyday productivity moments: sketching ideas, presenting clearly, joining video meetings with confidence, and working securely from changing locations. CUSTOMER PROBLEM.content:

Today’s leaders do not work in a single posture. They move from ideation to presentation to video collaboration, often outside a fixed desk setup. The product sheet addresses this unmet need through a lightweight 2-in-1 convertible design, touch input, tablet mode, tent mode, and PC mode.

The second pain point is meeting presence. In hybrid work, the device must help users appear composed and be clearly heard without manual tuning. The sheet supports this with Poly Camera Pro for smart framing/background support and spotlight, plus Dynamic Voice Leveling and AI Noise Reduction.

The third pain point is confidence under enterprise security expectations. AI-powered workflows and mobile work increase the need for resilient protection. HP Wolf Security for Business addresses this with hardware-enforced, always-on defense from BIOS to browser. The brief should frame security as enabling freedom to work anywhere, not as a technical afterthought.

USE CASES.content:
**Use case 1: The mobile leader turns a rough idea into a persuasive discussion.**  
A business leader moves from a hallway concept to a working session. In tablet mode, they sketch or annotate ideas using touch input. In tent mode, they present the concept to a small group. In PC mode, they refine the work and collaborate. The product fits because the 2-in-1 design is explicitly built for sketching, presenting, and collaborating, helping ideas flow without switching devices.

**Use case 2: The hybrid executive shows up clearly in high-stakes meetings.**  
A mobile professional joins back-to-back video calls from varied environments. They need to look framed, reduce visual distractions, and be heard clearly. Poly Camera Pro helps keep them framed and distraction-free with smart background adjustments and spotlight. Dynamic Voice Leveling enhances microphone gain within 3 meters, while AI Noise Reduction supports a clearer audio experience, even while wearing a mask.

**Use case 3: The security-conscious business user works from changing locations.**  
A professional works across office, home, travel, and dense wireless environments. They need reliable connectivity and enterprise protection. Wi-Fi 7 supports fast, reliable connections in dense environments, while HP Wolf Security for Business provides hardware-enforced, always-on, resilient defense from BIOS to browser. This scenario should emphasize confidence to work anywhere, without claiming total risk elimination.
